records.claim: Taking azathioprine or 6-MP has not been shown to affect a man’s fertility (ability to make healthy sperm) or increase the chance of birth defects. A large study that combined the results of many studies did not find a higher chance of birth defects or other problems at birth in babies fathered by men taking these medications. In general, exposures that men have are less likely to increase risks to a pregnancy. For more information, please see the MotherToBaby fact sheet Paternal Exposures at https://mothertobaby.org/fact-sheets/paternal-exposures-pregnancy/.
